field_edits.updated_text: Mild diffuse osseous demineralization. No acute fracture or focal osseous lesion. Mild degenerative changes involving the radiocarpal/intercarpal and first carpometacarpal joints with small marginal osteophytes. Mild degenerative changes of the visualized elbow.
Mild degenerative changes involving the radiocarpal/intercarpal and first carpometacarpal joints with small marginal osteophytes. Mild degenerative changes of the visualized elbow. No dislocation.

impression:
1. Mild diffuse osseous demineralization.
2. Mild osteoarthritic changes of the left wrist (radiocarpal/intercarpal and first carpometacarpal joints) with marginal osteophytes.
3. Mild degenerative changes of the visualized elbow.
4. No acute fracture or dislocation of the left wrist or forearm.
